cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this room ready to show the landlord. Help me settle the curtains before we open his rent letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll send a picture of how well we're looking after the place. You choose the angle; I'll arrange it to suit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send the picture and ask if we're behind on rent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a picture first. Shall I move this end of the curtain or that one? I'll keep adjusting until you're happy with the shot; you can tell me when we're ready to send anything.

reason: Let A adopt B contact proposal selectively while yielding photo direction, using cooperative curtain adjustments to keep the same rent-status subject unreached.
